scope: Eight first responses from all contexts of two exposed development pairs; interface feasibility only
primary_endpoint: Exactly one complete native action meeting the unchanged four-action semantic schema
secondary_engineering_check: Provider prompt usage equals pinned local reference count; discrepancy terminates without empirical offset adjustment
failure_policy: Format-invalid response retained as observed invalid; no repair or retry. Transport, identity, usage or deadline failure stops remaining slots, retaining all not-started slots and unknown billing reserves.

decision_rules.infrastructure_failure: Stop and audit; no automatic restart
decision_rules.any_invalid_action: Do not resume substantive experiments with this interface; review failure without cell-selective retries
decision_rules.eight_valid_actions: Limited interface check passed; not task correctness or intent-drift evidence. Further paid experiments require a separate design and approval.
